comparison.objective: Punch a wire into a 110 block and trim its loose end; candidate removes a crimped wire terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and drive a punch-down tool to seat and cut wire versus guide two blades around a terminal, depress tangs, and pull the intact crimped wire out.
comparison.success_condition: Requires electrical seating and clean trimming without cutting the run; candidate requires intact wire-to-terminal attachment and selective extraction without collateral damage. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both concern connector wiring, but one terminates and cuts a conductor while the other releases a retained crimp contact intact.
